purpose: Teach: あらわす/すすめる/雇う/建つ/散る/知ろ/ずばり/いちど

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはお絵描きで気持ちをあらわすのが好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know I like to show my feelings through drawing.
lines.style: Warm and reflective, speaking as an older sister sharing something personal. Soft voice, unhurried. A gentle teacher's patience underneath, inviting him into her world.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達にお絵描きをすすめるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to tell my friend they should draw too.
lines.style: Bright and earnest, speaking with the simple certainty of a child who's just had a good idea. Quick to say, but thoughtful—not just excited noise.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの友達も、新人を雇うって悩んでらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, one of my friends is worried about hiring someone new at work.
lines.style: Musing, half to herself. Noticing Sho's attentiveness. Warm but distant in the way of someone thinking through something. Trailing slightly, inviting connection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、新しい家が建つの楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm looking forward to when the new house gets built.
lines.style: Bright and open-hearted, sharing something he's been thinking about. Simple joy without showing off. The voice of a child who trusts he'll be listened to.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、桜の花びらが散る公園、綺麗ね
lines.en: Sho, the cherry blossoms falling in the park—it's so beautiful.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. She's noticing something and wanting him to notice it too. Quiet contentment. Breath carries a moment of peace, trailing gently on 'beautiful.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのお話、もっと知ろうって思ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to know more about Grandpa's stories.
lines.style: Sincere and reaching—he's realized something matters to him and he's saying it clearly. Not hesitant, but careful with the words, like they carry weight for a small person.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ずばり、メイ姉さんはお祖父ちゃんを尊敬してるのよ
lines.en: Sho, if you want to know the truth, I really respect your grandfather.
lines.style: Direct and genuine, giving him something honest. 'Frankly' lands with quiet emphasis. Warm gaze. She's telling him something true, not performing, and trusting him to understand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、いちどメイ姉さんと泊まりに行きたい
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to stay over somewhere with you sometime.
lines.style: Soft and tender, speaking a small wish he's been holding. Not demanding, just hopeful. The voice of a child offering closeness—vulnerable but uncomplicated.
